name: Authorized administrator access
description: ADMIN-PC uses the SIEM and EDR consoles under explicit Zero Trust permissions; PC-1 tries the same SIEM and is stopped.

presentation.objective: Show that access to the Security VLAN is explicit, not implied by being an administrator.
presentation.security_rule: Zero Trust: the admin role is explicitly permitted tcp/443 on SIEM-1 and tcp/8443 on EDR-MGMT-1. PC-1 is stopped earlier by STAFF-IN rule 20.
presentation.explanation: CORE-SW1 asks ZT-POLICY-1 about each request to a protected resource. ADMIN-PC is trusted and its role holds the permission, so both sessions are allowed and the decisions list the identity, role, device trust and permission used. PC-1 never gets as far as Zero Trust: the STAFF-IN ACL drops it.
expected: Two Zero Trust allow decisions for ADMIN-PC, each with its reasons
SIEM-1 and EDR-MGMT-1 answer the administrator
PC-1's request to SIEM-1 is dropped at CORE-SW1 by STAFF-IN:20
The difference between the two policies is visible
